$schema.description: Defines the schema to use for a policy set definition.

properties.description: Defines the properties of the policy set.

scope.description: Defines the scope of the policy set.

type.description: The scope type. Supported values and length restrictions are defined by the policy platform rather than constrained by this schema.

policyRules.description: Defines the rules in the policy set.

displayName.description: The display name of the policy rule. Free-form text with no length restrictions imposed by this schema.

description.description: An optional description of the policy rule. Free-form text with no length restrictions imposed by this schema.

policy.description: The policy type governed by the rule.

conditions.description: Defines the conditions of the policy rule.

effects.description: Defines the effects of the policy rule.

type.description: Identifies a static condition. Only Static is permitted.
Identifies a dynamic condition. Only Dynamic is permitted.

targetProperty.description: The property evaluated by the condition, expressed as an identifier or a dot-separated property path.

predicate.description: Defines the comparison applied to the target property.

operator.description: The comparison operator applied to the target property and the supplied values.

values.description: The values used for comparison with the target property.

items.description: A comparison value. Allowed values and length restrictions depend on the target property and are not constrained by this schema.

type.description: Identifies the effect of the policy rule. Only Allow is permitted.
